folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B291: complete map and source-provenance scope
folds.body:
The full [917-line remainder map](COVERAGE.json) and [409-line provenance map](missed-provenance/COVERAGE.json) were read row by row. All 19 packet rows partition into home4, combat objectives4, livelihood3, combat fit3, consequences3 and offers2. Each retains source/native/UI/persistence consumers, its dated build and behaviorVerified=false. Their inherited state string saying queued candidate describes the earlier intake, while the later status reports source integration at this historical closeout. Neither field grants current dispatch; no row is a newly played or persisted mechanic. The five additional obligations repeat connected parent-queue scope rather than supply independent runtime evidence.

Keep the different consumer promises explicit: actual owned shifts/tool allocation; useful covered work, measuring jig and earned specialization; retained funded offers backed by actual supply; friction expiry separate from a promise and a cause-funded response; actual fit/body/source contributions to a guarded maneuver; and paid maintained brace, physical preparation and usable recovered fitting/recipe. A common main/save/UI filename in every row is not proof that these different branches were exercised. ALL19 plus the earlier three is the finite 22-source-delivery denominator. It does not close whole-world, novel parity, generic NPC behavior or the separately unrun model/browser/save/failure/keyboard work.

MW-03's 19 provenance rows are also a different denominator. The classes are twelve supplied-novel profiles, three game references, two manga/anime references, one original profile and one bounded publisher reference. Their 20 edition pins, 172 citations, 126 reviewed-source references and 39 member pins count different things; one title has two edition pins. They establish neither 19 full novels nor 172 newly checked sources. Zero member pins does not mean zero available source or complete source coverage. All activation=false flags describe those contracts at that snapshot; later selected book-world development retains its own current owner and evidence.

The internal ordinals, canonical IDs and zero-based row/source pointers are consistent across all 19 rows. This is a structural check of the map, not a fresh resolution of its assembled input. Nineteen repeated copies of one assembled-row hash identify the same input, not independent corroboration. Retained original/auxiliary source fields and unchanged non-source contract fields remain distinct claims; reviewed refs and retrievalResolvesExactRow=true are the historical repair's assertions until its exact source input is inspected. No underlying assembled row, primary book, game payload, source authenticity, current contract activation or runtime consumer is newly verified by this fold. Preserve all original JSON and evidence dates in place.
